limitations: No real exported profile.json has been supplied: the file decoder is VERIFIED_SYNTHETIC (round-trip with the live catalog).

The file decoder is deliberately NOT wired to engine.py: profile.json has suffix json and registering a json engine would claim every .json import; no filename-scoped route exists (see README.md and REPORT.md).
The ping list (kuay/ping.json, 8 hosts) is not part of the catalog and is not integrated.
No custom text scheme exists in the app; standard vmess/vless/trojan/ss links are covered by the generic V2Ray decoders.
network_requirements: live catalog fetch only (broker, plain GET); decoders run offline.
